description: Writable input, readable output. Implement `transform(chunk, encoding, callback)` and push zero or more outputs per chunk.
Runs once after the last input chunk, to push anything still buffered (the last line, a footer).
Streams carry arbitrary values instead of bytes. `readableObjectMode` / `writableObjectMode` set one side only.
`await pipeline(a, b, c)` from `node:stream/promises`: wires backpressure, destroys every stream on error and rejects with the first error.
`write()` returns `false` when the buffer is full; producers wait for `'drain'`. `pipeline` does it for you.
Newline-delimited JSON: one JSON value per line. Streams well because each line is parsed independently.
